Subject: Renewal QBR — micro-session rotation proposal

Hi Daniel / Maria,

As we prep for your renewal QBR, we've been thinking about minimizing the calendar footprint for your execs while still covering the roadmap and ops items that matter. Rather than a single 60–90 minute block, would your team be open to a set of three focused ~25–30 minute "micro-sessions" (product roadmap, infra & security, and rollout/pricing)?

Benefits:
- Shorter time commitments for execs (can join 1–2 sessions)
- Enables parallel follow-ups for deep dives without a big group call
- Easier to record and distribute concise segments to stakeholders

Proposed windows (all US/PDT):
- Option A: Wed 7/7 — 09:00–09:30, 10:00–10:30, 11:00–11:30
- Option B: Thu 7/8 — 13:00–13:30, 14:00–14:30, 15:00–15:30

Attached is a suggested agenda and a calendar poll link. If this sounds useful, can you share the must-have attendees per topic (e.g., CFO for pricing, CTO for infra)? I can propose specific small invites based on availability.

Attachments: [Attachment: qbr_micro_session_agenda.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]
Calendar poll: https://doodle.com/poll/abc123-qbr-micro

Thanks — happy to adapt.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0134
